2116530184895475893.en_summary: Ksidiii: Remember boiler room pump-and-dump schemes of the 2000s and garbage bonds in the 90s. People chuckle at who would fall for that. This is exactly what QIS is in today’s era. Banks charge a markup on absolute garbage strategies that never work, then rotate them in and out. Quoted on alpha decay of published strategies.
2116530184895475893.zh_summary: Ksidiii：記得2000年代的鍋爐房拉高出貨計劃和90年代的垃圾債券。人們嘲笑誰會上當。這正是今天時代的QIS。銀行對絕對垃圾策略收取加價，那些策略從不奏效，然後輪換進出。引用已發表策略的alpha衰減。

2116529342251462993.en_summary: juan_gonzalesP: Brent just printed $118 and the 10-year Treasury yield is at 4.94%. That relationship used to run the other way. @robin_j_brooks is correct, this is a regime shift. For most of 2026 oil up meant yields up; that link is broken. 20-day correlation between Brent and 10Y collapsed to lowest since late 2024. Reason is Europe; French 10-year at 4.96%, highest since 2002. Quoted Robin on structural break where 10Y yield falls as oil rises due to Europe debt crisis.
2116529342251462993.zh_summary: juan_gonzalesP：Brent剛印出$118，10年期國債收益率為4.94%。這種關係以前是相反的。@robin_j_brooks是對的，這是體制轉變。2026年大部分時間油價上漲意味收益率上漲；這種聯繫已斷裂。Brent和10Y的20日相關性降至2024年底以來最低。原因是歐洲；法國10年期為4.96%，為2002年以來最高。引用Robin關於10Y收益率隨油價上升而下降的結構性突破，因歐洲債務危機。
